# Ledgy

> Talk to your money. Ledgy is a multi-currency expense tracker for iOS. Free download with no ads. Optional Ledgy Cloud subscription ($2.99/mo or $22.99/yr) adds AI intake, multi-device sync, group sharing, Apple Watch logging, Telegram bot, web dashboard, and an MCP server that lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and any MCP-compatible AI assistant read, add, and edit your expenses in plain English. App Store ID: 6761738170.

## Key facts

- Platform: iOS 15+ (iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch)
- Price: Free download, no ads; Cloud subscription optional
- Cloud pricing: $2.99/month or $22.99/year (~$1.92/mo, save 36%), 7-day free trial
- Voice logging: on-device speech (Apple Speech framework); only resulting text sent to server
- Multi-currency: daily-refreshed ECB FX rates, per-account currency, primary currency conversion
- MCP server URL: https://api.ledgy.app/mcp (OAuth 2.0 / RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration)
- REST API base: https://api.ledgy.app/api/v1/
- Languages: 14 fully translated locales (EN, DE, ES, FR, HI, IT, JA, KO, PL, PT-BR, RU, TR, UK, ZH-Hans)
- CSV import: 29 locale auto-detection
- No ads, no tracking SDKs, no data brokers
- Data ownership: offline-first SQLite on device; cloud sync is encrypted

## Marketing

- [Home](https://ledgy.app/): overview, features, capture surfaces, MCP, FAQ
- [Plans & upgrade](https://dashboard.ledgy.app/upgrade): plan selector and web checkout (on the dashboard)
- [Integrations / MCP](https://ledgy.app/integrations): pick your assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client) and connect in about a minute — one-click install for ChatGPT and Cursor, copy-paste server URL for Claude and the rest; prompt examples, capabilities, privacy controls
- [Ledgy in ChatGPT](https://ledgy.app/chatgpt): import bank statements by chat (ChatGPT or Claude), connection steps, statement formats, trial and pricing FAQ

## Documentation

- [API v1 Reference](https://ledgy.app/api-v1): REST endpoints for accounts, categories, budgets, groups, transactions; PAT auth; bulk ops
- [Support / Help Center](https://ledgy.app/support): install, voice, Siri, Watch, Telegram, Apple Wallet, billing, troubleshooting
